mechanism: Naproxen may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism of armodafinil and both drugs can increase cardiovascular stress; naproxen also increases GI bleeding risk which armodafinil may potentiate through CNS stimulation effects.
action: Monitor for increased armodafinil adverse effects (tachycardia, hypertension, insomnia) and GI symptoms; consider alternative NSAID or increase gastroprotection if combination necessary.
